title: jfet
description: Junction FET component data (n- or p-channel; Si small-signal and low-noise JFETs, normally-on SiC power JFETs). The presence of the 'jfet' field at the top level of an SAS document discriminates the device type.

substitutesInfo.description: Replacement parts for this one: manufacturer-named successors and second sources. An entry with type 'successor' means THIS part is superseded by the named one, one hop, as the manufacturer states it - never inferred from a status of obsolete or from part-number similarity. The schema cannot check that the named part exists in the catalogue, or exists exactly once; that is the referential pass's job, as for CIAS component URIs. Evidence for the claim goes in the record's provenance[] with fields: ["substitutesInfo"], carrying the same sourceUrl, retrievedDate and verification stamp as any datasheet field.

spiceModel.description: Device-body SPICE .model card for a simulation-sourced part (no datasheet). Faithful home that does not require manufacturerInfo.

datasheetInfo.title: jfetDatasheetInfo
datasheetInfo.description: All information extracted from a JFET datasheet.

allOf.$comment: Device-specific narrowing of the shared part def: subType must come from this closed enum (protects the exact-string conditionals below).

dieConfiguration.description: 'dual' = two JFETs in one package (monolithic matched pairs); described per die.

dies.description: One entry per JFET die of a dual, INSTEAD OF the package-level electrical block.

matching.description: Matching specifications between die. Only legal on a part described per die.

allOf.$comment: A package that declares two or more die must describe them per die (the same gate as mosfet.json, from day one: there are no legacy rows to grandfather).
Matching relates die; it has nothing to attach to on a single-die record.

subType.title: jfetSubType
subType.description: Channel type of a junction FET. Requirement-side enums $ref this anchor.

electrical.title: jfetElectrical
electrical.description: JFET electrical characteristics - small-signal and low-noise JFETs (J111, 2SK, U40x, JFE150, LSK389) and normally-on SiC power JFETs (UnitedSiC UJ3N). Values SI. Absolute-maximum voltages and currents are magnitudes; the bias quantities whose sign carries meaning (V_GS(off), test V_GS) are signed exactly as printed (negative for an n-channel part). A SiC cascode (JFET + LV MOSFET, UJ3C/UJ4C/UF3C) is normally-off and is a mosfet.json part, not this file.

drainSourceVoltage.description: V_DS / V_DSS absolute maximum (or the guaranteed V_(BR)DSS where that is the only drain rating), in V.

gateDrainVoltageMax.description: V_GD / V_DG absolute maximum reverse gate-drain voltage, in V - the drain rating many small-signal JFETs print instead of V_DS (J111 'V_DG 35 V').

gateSourceVoltageMax.description: V_GS / V_GSS absolute maximum reverse gate-source voltage (or V_(BR)GSS), in V, as a magnitude. Same name as the mosfet field.

gateForwardCurrentMax.description: I_GF / I_GS absolute maximum forward gate current, in A.

continuousDrainCurrent.description: I_D / I_DS absolute maximum drain current, in A. Same name as the mosfet field.

saturationDrainCurrent.description: I_DSS: drain current at V_GS = 0, in A (magnitude), at saturationDrainCurrentVds. Graded parts (2SK209-GR) are catalogued per orderable grade.

saturationDrainCurrentVds.description: Drain-source voltage at which saturationDrainCurrent is specified, in V, signed as printed.

gateSourceCutoffVoltage.description: V_GS(off) / V_P / V_GSC: gate-source voltage at which the drain current falls to cutoffDrainCurrent, in V, SIGNED as printed (-1.5..-0.9 V for an n-channel part).

cutoffDrainCurrent.description: Drain current that defines gateSourceCutoffVoltage, in A (0.1 uA = 1e-7).

cutoffDrainSourceVoltage.description: Drain-source voltage at which gateSourceCutoffVoltage is specified, in V, signed as printed.

transconductance.description: g_fs / g_m at each printed bias (see jfetTransconductance).

onResistance.description: r_DS(on) at V_GS = 0 (switch JFETs, SiC JFETs), in Ohm. Same name as the mosfet field.

gateLeakageCurrent.description: I_GSS / I_G gate leakage (reverse gate current), in A (magnitude), at gateLeakageVoltage.

gateLeakageVoltage.description: Gate-source voltage at which gateLeakageCurrent is specified, in V, signed as printed.

inputCapacitance.description: C_iss, in F, at capacitanceMeasurementVds. Same name as the mosfet field.

reverseTransferCapacitance.description: C_rss, in F. Same name as the mosfet field.

outputCapacitance.description: C_oss, in F. Same name as the mosfet field.

capacitanceMeasurementVds.description: Drain-source voltage at which the capacitances are specified, in V. Same name as the mosfet field.

totalGateCharge.description: Q_g of a power JFET, in C. Same name as the mosfet field.

voltageNoiseDensity.description: Input-referred voltage noise density e_n, in V/sqrt(Hz). Same name and unit as AAS amplifierCommon.voltageNoiseDensity and bjt.json, so one query covers op amps, matched BJTs and JFETs. Typical column.

voltageNoiseDensityFrequency.description: Frequency at which voltageNoiseDensity is specified, in Hz.

voltageNoiseDensityDrainCurrent.description: Drain current at which voltageNoiseDensity is specified, in A (a JFET's e_n falls with I_D).

currentNoiseDensity.description: Input current noise density i_n, in A/sqrt(Hz) (the AAS name). Typical column.

currentNoiseDensityFrequency.description: Frequency at which currentNoiseDensity is specified, in Hz.

transconductance.title: jfetTransconductance
transconductance.description: Forward transconductance at one stated bias. JFET datasheets print it at full conduction (V_GS = 0, the classic g_fs / y_fs) and at one or more operating currents (g_m at I_D = 2 mA), so each is an entry.

drainCurrent.description: Drain current of the test, in A (magnitude). Absent with gateSourceVoltage 0 = full conduction.

gateSourceVoltage.description: Gate-source voltage of the test, in V, signed as printed (0 for full conduction).

drainSourceVoltage.description: Drain-source voltage of the test, in V, signed as printed.

matching.title: jfetMatching
matching.description: One matching specification between the die of a dual JFET (LSK389, U401-U406, 2SK3557): how closely the named die agree at the stated conditions. Sits beside dies[] (a property of a pair, never of one die), like bjt.json matching. Magnitudes.

dies.description: Names (dies[].name) of the die related. Absent = any two die of the part.

gateSourceVoltageMatch.description: |V_GS1 - V_GS2| at equal drain current (the pair's offset), in V.

gateSourceVoltageMatchDrift.description: Temperature drift of the V_GS match, in V/K.

saturationDrainCurrentMatch.description: I_DSS match |1 - I_DSS1/I_DSS2| as a fraction.

transconductanceMatch.description: g_fs match |1 - g_fs1/g_fs2| as a fraction.

testDrainCurrent.description: Drain current per die at which the matching is specified, in A.

testDrainGateVoltage.description: Drain-gate voltage at which the matching is specified, in V.

testTemperature.description: Ambient temperature of the test, in degC.

die.title: jfetDie
die.description: One JFET die inside a multi-die package, with the complete JFET electrical block the single-device file defines: same physics, same field names, stated once per die (per-die values as the datasheet prints them 'per device' / 'each'; a package total is never divided down).

subType.description: Type OF THIS DIE where the die of one package differ.

electrical.description: The complete JFET electrical block, per die.

thermal.description: Per-die thermal figures where the datasheet gives them. The package figure stays in datasheetInfo.thermal.
